faces.name: Coveted Falcon
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, gain control of target permanent you own but don't control.
Disguise {1}{U}
When this creature is turned face up, target opponent gains control of any number of target permanents you control. Draw a card for each one they gained control of this way.

faces.name: Coveted Jewel
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, draw three cards.
{T}: Add three mana of any one color.
Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.

faces.name: Coveted Peacock
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, you may goad target creature defending player controls. (Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)

faces.name: Coveted Prize
faces.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature in your party. (Your party consists of up to one each of Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard.)
Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. If you have a full party, you may cast a spell with mana value 4 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Covetous Castaway
faces.oracleText:
When this creature dies, mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
Disturb {3}{U}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard transformed for its disturb cost.)

faces.name: Ghostly Castigator
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may shuffle up to three target cards from your graveyard into your library.
If Ghostly Castigator would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

faces.name: Covetous Dragon
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When you control no artifacts, sacrifice this creature.

faces.name: Covetous Elegy
faces.oracleText: Each player chooses up to two creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest. Then you create a tapped Treasure token for each creature your opponents control.

faces.name: Covetous Urge
faces.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from that player's graveyard or hand and exile it. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
